question: A churn model on /work/data/customers.csv scores about 0.97 test accuracy. Can the team rely on that accuracy when it scores current customers at the start of a quarter?
background: customers.csv has 2000 rows: six activity columns, cancel_reason, and the label churned. Model: StandardScaler, then LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000), on a fixed 25% stratified test split with random_state=0. Marketing wants to use it to pick customers for a retention offer.
